$comment: extractInviteCode(text): the invite code inside anything a user pastes or types (a bare code, a proseio.com.br/convite/ link, a whole share message). Rule: uppercase the text; find the first match of PATTERN; drop the separators; format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. No match: null. Alphabet ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 (no 0/O, 1/I/L), same as proseio-api newInviteCode(). Separators between groups: none, one space, or one hyphen or dash (U+002D, U+2010, U+2011, U+2012, U+2013, U+2014, U+2212). The pattern is portable: ICU (Swift), java.util.regex (Kotlin), V8 (JS). Hand-written: edit here, then make every platform pass.
